page_title: BAR 1-0 RAY | Barcelona v Rayo Vallecano 22/03/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The match has just finished.
90+6' The ball possession at the moment is 61:39.
90+1' Pacha (Rayo Vallecano) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender. Rayo Vallecano win a corner.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Xavi Espart (Barcelona) comes onto the pitch for Joao Cancelo.
90' The referee blows his whistle, Rayo Vallecano are awarded a corner kick.

89' Joan Garcia pulls off a great save to deny Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick low drive to the bottom left corner. Rayo Vallecano have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
88' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Adrian Cordero didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
83' CHANCE! Pacha (Rayo Vallecano) picks up a pass inside the box and has a sight of goal, but he blazes his shot well over the top. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Barcelona.
82' Inigo Perez has decided to substitute Fran Perez and he is replaced by Sergio Camello (Rayo Vallecano).
82' The referee allows time for a substitution. Lamine Yamal will be replaced by Marcus Rashford (Barcelona).
81' Rayo Vallecano failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
80' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first. Rayo Vallecano have a corner.
80' The referee blows his whistle, a clear handball by Gerard Martin (Barcelona). Rayo Vallecano are awarded the free kick.
73' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Fran Perez (Rayo Vallecano).
72' Pau Cubarsi (Barcelona) is awarded a yellow card. The referee showed him no mercy.
70' Raphinha (Barcelona) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
69' Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) is caught offside!

68' Dani Olmo (Barcelona) has a chance after receiving a pass. He measures his shot from the edge of the box but it sails just wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Rayo Vallecano.
67' Raphinha (Barcelona) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
67' A yellow card for a tackle by Fran Perez (Rayo Vallecano). Adrian Cordero doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
66' Pathe Ciss (Rayo Vallecano) will miss the next game because of that yellow card.
65' The game is interrupted because of a yellow card that is shown to Pathe Ciss (Rayo Vallecano).
64' A pass from Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) is intercepted by Joan Garcia and the move breaks down.
63' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Rayo Vallecano.

63' What a great chance for Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano). He times his jump superbly when he leaps high to meet a precise cross from the corner, directing his towering header right under the bar, but the goalkeeper denies him with a miraculous save. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Rayo Vallecano will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
62' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) will take the corner.
62' Rayo Vallecano have been awarded a corner kick.

61' That was a nice football moment. Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano) receives an amazing defence-splitting low pass on the edge of the box and blasts the ball towards the top left corner. Joan Garcia guesses his intention and dives superbly to deny him with a remarkable save! Corner kick. Rayo Vallecano will have an opportunity.
61' Hansi Flick prepares a substitution. Fermín is replaced by Dani Olmo (Barcelona).
61' The substitution is prepared. Marc Casado (Barcelona) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Marc Bernal.

60' Golden chance! Fermín (Barcelona) meets a cross in the box and finds some space for a shot. He produces an inaccurate effort that goes wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Rayo Vallecano.
59' Inigo Perez has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jorge de Frutos (Rayo Vallecano) replacing Pedro Diaz.
59' It will be a substitution. Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) is ready to enter the pitch as Gerard Gumbau walks off.
57' Fermín (Barcelona) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Adrian Cordero blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Rayo Vallecano in a dangerous position.

57' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Lamine Yamal (Barcelona), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Rayo Vallecano will have a goal kick.

56' Barcelona slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
53' Fermín (Barcelona) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
51' Fermín (Barcelona) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
49' Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
48' The foul by Fermín (Barcelona) was seen by Adrian Cordero who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle. Rayo Vallecano have a free kick.
47' Joao Cancelo (Barcelona) prepares to take a corner kick.
46' The game is over for Oscar Valentin. Pacha (Rayo Vallecano) comes on for the second half.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Inigo Perez probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Carlos Martin. He is replaced by Alvaro Garcia (Rayo Vallecano).
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Robert Lewandowski (Barcelona) is replaced by Ferran Torres.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+4' Adrian Cordero has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+3' Joao Cancelo (Barcelona) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.

45+2' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Raphinha (Barcelona). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate. Barcelona force a corner. They send men into the box.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
45' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Rayo Vallecano.
45' It will be a corner kick for Rayo Vallecano.

44' Carlos Martin (Rayo Vallecano) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. The ball is out of play and Rayo Vallecano manage to earn a corner.
43' The ball goes behind for a corner. Rayo Vallecano will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
39' Flag up against Pep Chavarria (Rayo Vallecano). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
38' Fermín (Barcelona) commits a foul and Adrian Cordero immediately signals a free kick. A free kick to Rayo Vallecano.
36' Andrei Ratiu (Rayo Vallecano) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
34' It's a yellow card for Oscar Valentin (Rayo Vallecano).
31' Corner kick. Raphinha (Barcelona) is ready to send the ball into the box.

30' Raphinha (Barcelona) picks up a rebound on the edge of the box and releases a nice strike towards the top right corner. Unfortunately for him, Augusto Batalla pulls off a decent save and manages to push the ball against the post.
30' Joao Cancelo (Barcelona) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
29' Dangerous play by Pep Chavarria (Rayo Vallecano). Adrian Cordero blows his whistle for a foul. Barcelona are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
26' Adrian Cordero shows the yellow card to Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) for a heavy challenge.
24' 1 - 0 Ronald Araujo (Barcelona) gets his head on a Joao Cancelo corner kick and plants a long-range header goalwards. The ball goes in off the right post and the score is 1:0.
24' The referee awards a corner and Joao Cancelo (Barcelona) goes over to take it.
23' Raphinha (Barcelona) will deliver the corner kick.

23' Raphinha (Barcelona) anticipates the lofted pass and races into the box with just the keeper to beat. He shoots early towards the roof of the net, but Augusto Batalla pulls off a great save to deny him. Barcelona earn a corner.
20' Joan Garcia (Barcelona) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
20' Lamine Yamal (Barcelona) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
18' The referee blows his whistle for a foul after Fermín (Barcelona) overruns the ball during an attack and makes an aggressive challenge on his opponent. A free kick is awarded to Rayo Vallecano.
14' The linesman points to the corner flag, Barcelona are going to take it.
14' Ronald Araujo (Barcelona) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The ball is out of play. Barcelona will have a chance to score from a corner.

13' A short pass finds Raphinha (Barcelona) in acres of space on the edge of the box and he decides to go for glory. His efforts looks in for all the world but just creeps past the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Rayo Vallecano.
11' Joao Cancelo (Barcelona) serves up a nice cross, but Augusto Batalla punches the ball away.

11' A sweet pass finds Gerard Martin (Barcelona) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball low towards the middle of the goal. Augusto Batalla is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second.
8' Today's referee Adrian Cordero rightly decides to book Raphinha (Barcelona) for his harsh tackle.
7' Joao Cancelo (Barcelona) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul. Rayo Vallecano earn a free kick.
6' Carlos Martin (Rayo Vallecano) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Adrian Cordero has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle. That's a free kick to Barcelona.
3' Barcelona are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
2' Joan Garcia pulls off a great save to deny Carlos Martin (Rayo Vallecano), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick low drive to the bottom right corner.
1' The first half has started.
The players are on the pitch and Rayo Vallecano will have the kick-off.
Adrian Cordero will supervise the game today.
